Answers by topic

What can a complete court system include?

Depending on the project scope, a proposal can bring together the structure, glass, enclosures, turf, lighting, doors, net, anchors and installation accessories. The final scope is confirmed in writing for each location.

How much does a padel court cost?

KND does not publish a single fixed price because the model, quantity, site conditions, logistics, installation and technical options all change the scope. Share the location and project objective to receive a tailored proposal.

View related information · View related information

What is the difference between a panoramic and a super-panoramic court?

For a project, the relevant differences are the structural solution, sightlines and intended application. Each model page explains its starting point; the final selection is validated against the use case, venue and project requirements.

How are court materials confirmed?

Each system document separates published information from decisions that depend on the venue. Before a proposal is closed, KND reviews the environment, intended use, finishes and applicable technical requirements.

View related information · View related information

Which glass specification is used?

The glass specification is shown on the model sheet and confirmed for the real project. The same solution should not be assumed for every location, use case or local requirement.

Which turf suits an intensively used court?

The selection is reviewed against court hours, player profile, climate, maintenance and the available technical sheet. The KND range shows confirmed height, Dtex and density data; undocumented performance claims are validated in the proposal.

View related information · View related information

How is court lighting defined?

Lighting is coordinated with the court model, location and intended use. Levels, fixtures and any regulatory requirement are confirmed with the project’s technical information, not through a generic recommendation.

View related information · View related information

Is a fixed or retractable roof better?

Neither option is universally better. The decision depends on the required level of protection, venue operation, local conditions and project engineering. The roof range is the starting point for that technical conversation.

How long does it take to install a court?

KND does not publish a fixed timeframe because site preparation, logistics, court count, scope and local teams all change the programme. With those inputs, the team can review a realistic project sequence.

What site preparation is needed?

Site preparation is defined with the drawings, anchoring solution, location conditions and applicable regulation. It is best to share the available information before finalising the court specification.

How are international projects coordinated?

KND can coordinate specification, manufacturing, packaging, logistics and documentation with the project’s installation teams. Transport scope and responsibilities are set out in each proposal.

What maintenance does a court need?

Maintenance depends on the final selected components and operating conditions. Request the documentation applicable to the chosen system to plan tasks without assuming unverified frequencies.

Can colours and finishes be customised?

The structure, surface, lighting, access details and selected branding elements can be reviewed around the venue identity and conditions. Available options are confirmed in the coordinated proposal.

Where can I review warranty terms?

Applicable terms should be reviewed in the project documentation and proposal. If you need this information for a tender or purchasing decision, mention it when requesting information so the relevant documentation can be provided.

What information is needed to start a professional project?

It helps to share the city or country, court count, venue type, intended use, indoor or outdoor conditions, programme and any available drawings or design requirements. That lets the conversation start with the decisions that truly change the solution.

What exactly does the 3D configurator represent?

The configurator helps explore a preliminary combination of model, turf, structure, lighting and protection. It does not replace engineering, a technical sheet or final proposal confirmation for a specific location.
